We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: In 2011-2013, the defendant Ji (纪某) used his wife's teacher employment status to fraudulently obtain land compensation from village committee. He provided false documents, claimed his wife was a contract teacher (but she was a formal teacher, not eligible). He obtained 97000 RMB. He later turned himself in, returned money. So crime is fraud (诈骗) specifically "诈骗罪" (fraud). Possibly "骗取补偿款" is a type of fraud: "诈骗罪" (fraud). Could also be "非法占有" but typical classification: "诈骗" (fraud). No other crimes like "受贿" etc. So single crime: 诈骗.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
